heroSection.title: Restore soil function. Close your site faster.
heroSection.subtitle: Terra Revive is a pelleted soil amendment that rebuilds biology, structure, and nutrient cycling so native species establish without synthetics.

features.title: Oil and Gas Reclamation
features.description: Restore soil function on wellsites and access roads. Faster vegetative cover and smoother audits.

features.title: Mining and Industrial
features.description: Rebuild stockpiled topsoil and establish vegetation on disturbed mine sites with minimal re-mobilizations.

features.title: Contractors and EPCs
features.description: Deliver reliable reclamation outcomes with spec-grade products and on-site support.

steps.title: Apply while yellow iron is on site
steps.description: Broadcast, drill, or hydroseed Terra Revive pellets using standard equipment. No special handling required.

steps.title: Pellets integrate and feed biology
steps.description: Organic matter and minerals break down gradually, feeding soil microbes and rebuilding structure.

steps.title: Soil function returns and vegetation establishes
steps.description: Native species germinate and establish without synthetics. Sites close faster with fewer re-visits.

outcomes.title: Faster vegetative cover
outcomes.description: Native species establish in the first growing season on properly prepared sites.

outcomes.title: Healthier plant growth on stockpiled topsoil
outcomes.description: Rebuild biology in degraded topsoil and improve seed establishment rates.

outcomes.title: Fewer re-mobilizations and smoother audits
outcomes.description: Reduce risk of failed inspections and costly return visits.

outcomes.title: Compatible with standard methods
outcomes.description: Works with broadcast, drill incorporation, hydroseeding, and drone applications.
